author: AtditC
body:
Hello staff team!

At the second unofficial tournament of Tazz, my ex-teamleader Ambivalence_ wanted to play with us. He couldn't join because he was forum banned. He needed an alt to play in Patchi, so I gave him one of mine. And now it's banned for Anti Knockback. GG.

You should be able to IP check Ambi and my alt, so you can see all players who used it.
It should be:
-Atdit
-Rilo
-Ambi

If someone of them didn't give the password to any other players so they hacked. Anyways. If Ambi is "ban evading" or hacked, he should be banned on his main account too.

https://avicus.net/DaDiamondBrick#infractions


Greetings,
Atdit

replies.body:
Hello AtDitc,

Well, None of the above players you have mentioned have appeared on the ip check. Further more the ip check says it's an alt of DanTDMFan100, a well known ban evader. After getting an ip check on Ambi and his alt, poppambi, the account doesn't come up either. Is there any other evidence that you could provide that would show ambi ban evading?
